summary: Aura-Guard Compliance Auditor first-finish smoke pass. Backend /api/ and /api/health return 200 with expected payloads. Frontend Dashboard, Audit, Verification, Tamper Demo, and Report pages all render and function correctly. Tamper flow correctly flips integrity to FAIL with cascading hash-chain failures on DEC-0003; reset restores PASS. All required data-testids present and interactive.
passed: Dashboard: session-name shows Q1-2026 AI Decision Audit
KPI cards: total=10, compliant=5, warnings=3, violations=2
Header EVIDENCE INTEGRITY badge shows PASS initially
Verification page: 4 check-summary cards, all showing 10/10 records passing
Tamper Demo: selecting DEC-0003 + field 'reason' + Apply tamper flips header badge to FAIL and shows TAMPERED badge
Canonical, SHA-256, and Hash-chain continuity checks all FAIL after tamper (visually verified); Policy check remains PASS
tamper-reset-btn restores integrity to PASS and removes TAMPERED badge
Report page renders with title 'Compliance Audit Report', all 5 sections (Executive, Scope, Decision ledger, Evidence verification, Auditor attestation), disclaimer, and print-report-btn
notes: Test script initially guessed wrong testid keys 'tamper-check-sha256' and 'tamper-check-chain_continuity'; actual keys are 'tamper-check-sha256_integrity' and 'tamper-check-hash_chain_continuity' (per verification.js). This was a test-script issue, not an app bug. Screenshots confirm all 4 tamper checks render with correct PASS/FAIL states. Import JSON actual file upload not exercised (per request); hidden input verified present. Backend uses MONGO_URL/DB_NAME in .env but no auth/DB flows are used by this demo (client-side crypto only).
